blocks.text: Get a New Animal Every Month! Find the perfect science adventure for your child. Ages 3–5 Play-based animal learning for little explorers, built to do together. Guided activities built for preschool attention spans Builds early skills like fine motor, early math, and early literacy Open-and-go learning with minimal prep EXPLORE CUB CLUB Learn more Ages 5–12 Real zoology + hands-on STEM for big thinkers who love to build and discover. Deeper animal science with anatomy, adaptations, and geography connections STEM projects and activities that build critical thinking Great for independent learners who ask "why?" EXPLORE ZOOLOGIST CLUB Learn more Not sure which to pick? If your child is not reading yet or needs letter reinforcement, start with Cub Club. If your child is reading, choose Zoologist Club for deeper science and anatomy. Newer reader? Add the Early Reader option to Zoologist Club.
